reply_text:
Found two issues in `receipt-lines` against `main`:

1. **High — Printed prices are 100× too large** — `receipt/render.py:2`
   `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00`, not `$12.99`. Two coffees at 450 cents print `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`.
   **Fix:** Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-value assertions; `tests/test_render.py:10` currently derives its expectation from the same broken formatter.

2. **Medium — Receipt amounts aren’t right-aligned** — `receipt/render.py:7`
   The renderer pads the name to 20 characters rather than using the new 32-column `align()` helper. Different-length prices therefore end in different columns; the helper’s passing test doesn’t exercise the printed receipt.
   **Fix:** Route `render_line()` through `align()` and test that rendered amounts of different lengths end at column 32.

All 3 existing tests pass. No files changed.
